cases.title: Unsportsmanlike conduct
cases.where: Tengus City Terrors at South Burke Tsunami, week 13
cases.text:
Kalani Toatautua (LB, Terrors) drew a flag with 0:05 left in the fourth quarter for taunting after a play. Officials described it as a single gesture. The incident drew a reaction from the home crowd. It came at a point when his team was ahead by two scores.

Kalani Toatautua has until Friday to respond to the notice.

cases.title: Post about the league office
cases.where: Wolford Dragons at North Hatesei Bees, week 13
cases.text:
Prudence Eastbridge (RB, Bees) posted remarks about an opponent that the league described as unprofessional. It was shared widely before it was removed. Eastbridge apologized in a follow-up post. He said it was written late at night and in frustration. The post contained profanity.

The Bees say they have spoken with Prudence Eastbridge.
